qte.gui.title: QTE — Settings
qte.gui.hint1: Commands run as the player with permission level 2.
qte.gui.hint2: The player gets the tag qte_success, qte_fail or qte_skipped.
qte.gui.hint3: Map maker: /qte ignore add @s — QTE will not show for you.
qte.f.name: Name
qte.gui.hint4: Spectator and creative are skipped: /qte skip
qte.tip.new: Create a new preset with default settings.
qte.tip.copy: Copy the current preset under a new name.
qte.tip.delete: Delete the preset from the world (the last one cannot be deleted).
qte.tip.test: Preview on your screen only. Commands are NOT run, completely safe.
qte.tip.run: Runs the QTE on you for real, even in creative/spectator. Success and fail commands WILL run!
qte.tip.save: Save the preset in the world so it can be started with a command.
qte.tip.key: Click, then press the key or mouse button you want. Esc cancels.
qte.tip.name: Preset name: letters, digits, _ and -. Used in /qte start.
qte.tip.mode: Button mashing, holding a key, or hitting the zone with a needle.
qte.tip.count: How many presses (or hits) are needed.
qte.tip.seconds: Total time for the QTE. Run out and it fails.
qte.tip.hold: How many seconds the key must be held.
qte.tip.needle: Seconds for the needle to make a full turn. Lower is harder.
qte.tip.zone: Size of the hit zone in degrees. Smaller is harder.
qte.tip.misses: How many misses are allowed before failing.
qte.tip.decay: How fast the bar rolls back, % per second.
qte.tip.prompt: Custom prompt above the ring. Empty uses the default.
qte.tip.ok_text: Custom success text. Empty uses the default.
qte.tip.fail_text: Custom fail text. Empty uses the default.
qte.tip.show_timer: Show the ring and the remaining time.
qte.tip.pack: Clean is tidy sounds. Dark is muffled and eerie, for horror.
qte.tip.s_press: Sound for a press or a hit.
qte.tip.s_heart: Heartbeat when time is almost out.
qte.tip.pitch_rise: Press sound gets higher as the bar fills.
qte.tip.appear: How the QTE appears. Glitch and Creep suit horror.
qte.tip.fail_fx: Effect on failure. Blood makes red streaks drip down.
qte.tip.position: Where the QTE sits on screen.
qte.tip.scale: Size of the QTE on screen.
qte.tip.shake: Camera shake strength on presses, heartbeat and the ending.
qte.tip.vignette: Dark screen edges; they turn red and pulse with the heartbeat when time is low.
qte.tip.color: Main color as RRGGBB, for example D8D2C4.
qte.tip.danger: Danger and fail color as RRGGBB, for example B01818.
qte.tip.show_key: Show the key in the middle of the ring.
qte.tip.show_progress: Show the progress bar and counter.
qte.tip.lock: While the QTE runs the player cannot walk, attack or open the inventory.
qte.tip.on_success: Command on success, run as the player with permission 2. Example: say Survived
qte.tip.on_fail: Command on failure, run as the player with permission 2. Example: kill @s
commands.qte.ignore.add: Added to ignore list: %s of %s. They no longer see QTE.
